title: Struck by Lightning 7 Times
sources: Guinness World Records, 'Incredible story of man who survived being struck by lightning SEVEN times' (2023): Roy Sullivan, Shenandoah National Park ranger; strikes 1942-1977; lost big toenail (1942), eyebrows burned (1969), hair set on fire (1972, 1973, 1976)

Wikipedia, 'Roy Sullivan': Guinness recognises him as struck by lightning more recorded times than any other human; carried a can of water in case his hair was set on fire; was said to have been avoided by people in his later years

lines.text: This man was struck by lightning seven times.
And he survived every single one.
It burned off his toenail, his eyebrows,
and set his hair on fire.
So he kept a can of water in his truck.
